candidateReview.name: Soprano'S Pizza & Pasta
candidateReview.note: This is the Ballard/Loyal Heights branch at 7729 24th Ave NW, Seattle, WA 98117. Birdeye's listing for this exact address labels it 'Sopranos Pizza & Pasta - Ballard' with the same 'Soprano's Pizza & Pasta' branding and matching menu (calzones, pastas, build-your-own pizza) as the Lake City location already on file, indicating it is another branch of the same chain rather than a separate business.

directory.name: Varlamos Pizzeria
directory.note: Longtime Northeast Seattle neighborhood pizzeria known for oversized calzones alongside build-your-own pizzas and pastas.
